name: Jump
description:
A creature you touch can jump twice as high and three times as far as normal for the next minute. Roll Lore to see if you trigger any additional effects.

Describe the jump.
successes:
✨: The creature can also run up vertical surfaces up to half their speed.

🌞: You may target a second creature you touch.

💀: The creature is immediately thrown 20 ft in the air, taking falling damage as normal. If they hit a ceiling or other object above them, they take an additional 1d6 damage. Check a Condition.
